name: Stock Valuation Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.item_description,
    c.name                                                              AS category_name,
    b.name                                                              AS brand_name,
    COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0)                                       AS qty_in_hand,
    i.standard_purchase_price                                           AS unit_cost,
    ROUND(COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) * i.standard_purchase_price, 2)  AS total_cost_value,
    i.standard_sales_price                                              AS unit_sales_price,
    ROUND(COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) * i.standard_sales_price, 2)     AS total_sales_value,
    ROUND(
        (COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) * i.standard_sales_price) - 
        (COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) * i.standard_purchase_price), 
        2
    )                                                                   AS potential_profit,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN i.standard_sales_price > 0 
            THEN ((i.standard_sales_price - i.standard_purchase_price) / i.standard_sales_price) * 100 
            ELSE 0 
        END, 
        2
    )                                                                   AS margin_pct
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id
LEFT JOIN m_brands b ON b.id = i.brand_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        m.item_code,
        SUM(m.qun_in - m.qun_out) AS qty_in_hand
    FROM t_item_movements m
    WHERE m.BC = :bc
      AND (:store_id IS NULL OR m.store_id = :store_id)
      AND (:to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to)
      AND (:from IS NULL OR :from <= :to)
    GROUP BY m.item_code
) stk ON stk.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE i.BC = :bc
  AND (:category IS NULL OR i.category_id = :category OR c.parent_id = :category)
  AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR i.brand_id = :brand_id)
  AND (:search IS NULL OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR i.item_description LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
  AND (
      :only_in_stock IS NULL
      OR :only_in_stock = ''
      OR :only_in_stock = 'NO'
      OR COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) > 0
  )
ORDER BY total_cost_value DESC, i.item_code;
